question: Where should a penalty taker aim?
answer: Placement barely matters. High scores 75%, low 72% and centre 76%, and the CIs overlap. Shootout kicks score 66% against 75% in play.
findings: Upper half of the goal: 74.7% scored (CI 70.5%-78.4%, n=462). Lower half: 71.5% (n=685). Misses over the bar are included.
Centre third: 75.9% (CI 67.2%-82.9%, n=112), chosen on 10% of kicks.
The kicking foot's natural side scores 73.1% (n=617) and the open side 71.4% (n=419).
method: Every penalty with an end location, by thirds of the goal mouth (posts at y 36 and 44). High is an end height of 1 m or more. The outcome is scored, with Wilson 95% CIs. The keeper's dive direction isn't in the open data.
data: StatsBomb open data, 23 full seasons/tournaments (2015/16 EPL, Serie A, Ligue 1; men's WC/Euro/Copa/AFCON; ISL; women's leagues and tournaments), 1,148 penalties incl. 336 shootout kicks.
split_check: High against low: men 76% and 70%, women 73% and 74%, so the edge isn't consistent. The shootout gap holds (CIs apart).
